title: feat(plugin-map)!: retire the bare `map` node type key; `object-map` is the one spelling (objectui#10393)
body:
Fixes #10393
Clause-②: yes

Retires the bare `map` node type key registered by `@object-ui/plugin-map` (and with it the namespaced twin `view:map`), executing the objectui#8008 family ruling (record `5603555117`, route 3: retire the bare registration, keep `object-*`). `object-map` is now the one spelling. The stored view type `map` (`NamedListView.type`, `defaultViewType`, `CreateViewDialog`) is **not** touched.

Implemented by the `os-dev` agent dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`. Head measured: `c6d3f38b2`. Base: `09ab32bff`.

## Guard (triage `5825154518`, narrowed by the claim): does not fire

No non-test source resolves the renderer through `map` / `view:map`. Measured on the base tree, per site:

| instrument | hits in non-test source | control |
| --- | --- | --- |
| literal registry call on `map` / `view:map` (`get` / `has` / `getConfig` / `register` / `registerLazy` …) | 2 registrations only: `plugin-map/src/index.tsx` and `apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts` (both removed here). `InterfaceListPage`'s `allowedSet.has('map')` is a Set of view types, not the registry | `object-map` fires on the same pattern (both registrations + the `Registry.ts` doc example); an absent name (`zzmapabsent`) stays silent (exit 1) |
| a `view:` key built by template or concatenation | 2 hits, both `data-objectstack` metadata CACHE keys (`view:` + object + view name), not registry lookups | the 2 hits are the matcher firing |
| a node emitted with literal `type: 'map'` | 0 of 28 repo-wide hits are non-test | `object-map` fires in 11 non-test files |
| a node type taken from a stored view type | `ObjectView` and `ListView` both have a `case 'map'` that emits `object-map`; the other `type: view.type` sites build tab items, not nodes | — |

The 22 `type: 'map'` sites in 10 `ObjectMap.*.test.tsx` files all hand the node straight to the `ObjectMap` component's `schema` prop (JSX, not `SchemaRenderer`). That component does not read `type` for resolution, so they are **left as they are**. The only `schema.type` reads in `ObjectMap.tsx` are warning-memo keys. That file is held by objectui#10525 and is not edited.

## Named refusal or plain unregistration: plain unregistration

In `@object-ui/types` the literal `'map'` appears only in the stored view-type unions (`defaultViewType`, `NamedListView.type`, `ObjectViewSchema.defaultViewType`'s zod enum). It never appears as a component node type. The firing control is `'object-map'`: `objectql.ts` plus its zod mirror. `AnyComponentSchema` has no `map` arm, so there is nothing to turn into a named refusal. This matches the `gantt` precedent and is recorded in the tombstone docblock in `plugin-map/src/index.tsx`.

## What changed, and why each file

- `packages/plugin-map/src/index.tsx`: removes `ComponentRegistry.register('map', …, { namespace: 'view' })` and adds a tombstone docblock in the form of `plugin-gantt`'s. The comment that said two inline lists were pinned identical now describes one list.
- `apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts`: removes the lazy `map` / `view:map` stub. This is the same move objectui#8865 made for `gantt`. The lazy `object-map` stub stays.
- `packages/core/src/utils/record-source.ts`: removes the `'view:map'` and `map` rows from `RECORD_SOURCE_DATA_ARM_BY_TYPE` and updates the doc comment (the one-block-spelling note on `ObjectMap.tsx`, and the alias example now uses `view:calendar` / `calendar`). Two sentences said every one of these renderers is registered twice. That was already false for `gantt` and this change makes it false for `map`, so both now say "most".
- `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts`: regenerated with `node scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs`. Bare `map` leaves the list. `view:map` stays, because the opt-in protocol placeholder registers it. That is the same outcome as `view:gantt` in objectui#8865, and the changeset says so.
- `.github/prompts/component.prompt.md`: the list-view `Keys:` bullet taught `view:map`. After this change that key answers only the placeholder, so `check:prompt-keys` would go red. It now teaches `object-map`, and the prose names `view:map` among the retired namespaced spellings. `scripts/__tests__/check-prompt-component-keys.test.ts` follows: the keys-line pin, and `view:map` added to the prose-only tombstones.
- `packages/plugin-map/README.md`: now says one registered type is `object-map`. It keeps the sentence that a stored `map` view compiles to `object-map`, and adds a retirement note that separates the two layers. The false bare-array sentence carried from objectui#10392's ACCEPT is corrected (see below).
- Pins that enumerated the retired keys drop them. They still pass on the `object-map` rows:
  - `index.recordSourceInput-7470.test.tsx` and `index.recordSourceInputs-10394.test.tsx` drop the `view:map` row. The 10394 "both keys publish identical lists" row is removed because only one list is left.
  - `index.registration.test.tsx` drops its `has('map', 'view')` non-vacuity line. `has('object-map', 'plugin-map')` stays.
  - `ObjectMap.schemaDataShorthand.test.tsx` 3d now asserts the renderer's key group is EXACTLY `object-map` and `plugin-map:object-map`.
  - `SchemaRenderer.dataPropArm-9571.test.tsx` and `SchemaRenderer.legacyPropsDataStrip-9758.test.tsx` (`@object-ui/react`, test-only) drop `view:map` and `map` from their object-arm lists. Those lists mirror the table rows removed above.
- New pin `packages/plugin-map/src/index.bareMapKeyRetired-10393.test.tsx`:
  - row 1: `map` / `view:map` resolve nothing; the firing control is that `object-map` resolves.
  - row 2: both authoring faces now refuse a `map` node. The html tier (`validateTree` over the live registry) reports `unknown-component`, and the Zod face (`safeValidateSchema`) refuses it as before. The control is that the same content spelled `object-map` passes both.
  - row 3: the source registers exactly one key, read off disk with comments masked.
- `.changeset/10393-retire-bare-map-key.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-map` minor, with a **BREAKING** body (never `major`, per AGENTS.md §9). `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/cli` and `@object-ui/console` are patch.

Checked and left alone (the other packages objectui#8865 touched): `runner` and `sdui-parser`. In that PR their changes were the kanban manual-registration map and the kanban quick-add. Neither package references a `map` node key.

**The stored layer is untouched, and existing tests already pin it.** Nothing is duplicated here:
- `plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.mapFlatten.test.tsx`: a stored `type: 'map'` view emits an `object-map` node. Re-run green in this change.
- `plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.listViewMapConfigReach.test.tsx`: a `viewType: 'map'` list view draws markers through `object-map`. Green.

## README sentence carried from objectui#10392's ACCEPT

The README claimed that `staticData`, a bare array under `data` and `data: { provider: 'value', items }` "all reach the same in-memory adapter". That has been false since objectui#8348 / #10394. The sentence now matches the registration's `data` description: a bare array under `data` is not a record source, the ladder falls through to `staticData` and then `objectName`, and inline rows belong under `staticData`. Two more phrases in the same README said "an inline `data` array" (the `titleField` row and the `dataSource` prop row). They now read `data: { provider: 'value', items }` configuration. This is the same claim in the same file, fixed in place.

## Red then green, for every new or strengthened pin

Red leg: `packages/plugin-map/src/index.tsx` was restored to base `09ab32bff` with `git checkout BASE -- path`, after the fix was committed.
- The mutation landed on disk: `label: 'Map View'` count went 0 → 1 and the tombstone count 1 → 0.
- The restore was `git checkout HEAD -- path` under a trap. The blob hash after the restore equals the HEAD blob `58dd6164…`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

| --- | --- | --- |
| bareMapKeyRetired row 1 (`map` resolves nothing) | ✗ `expected true to be false` | ✓ |
| row 1 FIRING CONTROL (`object-map` resolves) | ✓ | ✓ |
| row 2 (both faces refuse `map`) | ✗ `expected [] to deeply equal [ 'unknown-component' ]` | ✓ |
| row 2 CONTROL (`object-map` passes both) | ✓ | ✓ |
| row 3 (source registers one key) | ✗ `expected [ 'object-map', 'map' ] to deeply equal [ 'object-map' ]` | ✓ |
| schemaDataShorthand 3d (key group is exactly the two `object-map` keys) | ✗ received `map`, `object-map`, `plugin-map:object-map`, `view:map` | ✓ |

Base leg: `Tests 4 failed | 11 passed (15)`. Head leg: `Tests 15 passed (15)`.

## Acceptance notes

- `view:map` survives as a **placeholder** key in the console (`registerPlaceholders()` → `PROTOCOL_COMPONENTS`) and on the generated CLI list. That is the same state objectui#8865 left `view:gantt` / `view:kanban` in. Removing it from `PROTOCOL_COMPONENTS` would be a separate decision and is out of scope here.
- `.changeset/10392-registration-record-source-inputs.md`, which is pending, says that `object-map`, `map` and `object-gantt` now declare `data` / `staticData`. It will publish in the same release as this retirement. That was true when written and is left untouched (it is another card's changeset). The seat may want to read the two entries together.
- `skills/objectui/guides/architecture.md` ("Pattern A: The Component Registry") shows a user registering their OWN `MapRenderer` as `map` under `namespace: 'plugin-map'`. It is an extension example, not a claim about this plugin, and it stays true. It is also a governed surface, so it is left alone.
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-map.mdx` (the `filter` / `sort` paragraph) and `content/docs/fields/location.mdx` (the `Note` under the map example) repeat the same false bare-array-under-`data` claim. They are not in this claim's file surface and are reported for the seat, not fixed here.
